verdict.rationale: The entrepreneur blog discusses one interim option: a B-1 'in contemplation of an E-2' for a six-month visit to get the business set up. The services page lists TN (for Canadians and Mexicans) and consular processing, but only as visa categories, not framed as fallbacks. Nothing in the materials addresses running the company remotely while a petition is pending or what happens after a denial. Missing for 10: guidance on running the business remotely while waiting, Canadian or other third-country interim strategies framed as fallbacks, post-denial options (appeals, refiling, alternative visas), and any independent corroboration.
